items.title: Marriott (MAR) Stock Fair Value Rises After Q3 Beat And Higher Guidance
items.summary: Price targets for Marriott International have shifted into a higher range, with recent Street estimates now clustering between about US$400 and US$470, above the prior fair value estimate of roughly US$390.81 and closer to the updated figure near US$421.73. Analysts are tying these higher targets to Q3 results, raised guidance and a growing development pipeline, while also flagging some caution after the stock’s rally.
